content.title: What Time is WWE’s WrestleMania 42 Nights 1 & 2 on Netflix?
content.text: Picture: Roman Reigns on RAW Get ready for two incredible nights of WrestleMania as the superstars of the WWE head to Las Vegas for WrestleMania 42. Below is everything you need to know about WrestleMania 42, including the cards across both nights, start times, audio options, and more. Night 1 will see Cody Rhodes defend his Undisputed WWE Championship against former friend and mentor “the Viper” Randy Orton, who will also have Pat McAfee in his corner. Liv Morgan, the winner of the Women’s 2026 Royal Rumble, will face Stephanie Vaquer for the Women’s World Championship. Becky Lynch will attempt to settle her grudge with the reigning WWE Intercontinental Champion, AJ Lee, in a title match. Meanwhile, one of the world’s most popular streamers, IShowSpeed, will team up with Logan Paul and Austin Theory against The Usos and LA Knight in a Six-man tag team match. As for Night 2, World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk will defend his title against the “OTC” Roman Reigns. It’s also a clash of the titans as Oba Femi attempts to take down “the Beast” Brock Lesnar and establish himself as a future champion. Rhea Ripley also seeks championship gold, as she seeks to win the WWE Women’s Championship from Jade Cargill. Table of Contents What Time Does WrestleMania 42 Go Live? Is WrestleMania 42 Free to Watch on Netflix? What Audio Options is Netflix Providing for WrestleMania 42? WrestleMania 42 Night 1 Full Card Wrestlemania 42 Night 2 Full Card Can I stream WrestleMania 42 after the Main Event? How long will WrestleMania 42 Last? What to watch before Wrestlemania 42? What Time Does WrestleMania 42 Go Live? With 13 matches scheduled for WrestleMania, the event will be split across two days, Saturday and Sunday. For the second year in a row, WrestleMania is being hosted by Allegiant Stadium in Paradise, Nevada. US audiences streaming on Peacock won’t have a problem, as the event goes live at 6 PM EST / 3 PM PST. As for Netflix audiences, it will be a late start time or a bright-and-early start if you reside in East Asia or Oceania. Below we have the countdown to both nights of WrestleMania. WrestleMania 42 Night 1 Loading countdown... WrestleMania 42 Night 2 Loading countdown... Click Here To Watch WrestleMania 42 Live Is WrestleMania 42 Free to Watch on Netflix? Yep! However, whether you can watch WrestleMania on Netflix depends on where you live and whether Netflix has the distribution rights for WWE in that country. Netflix has confirmed that WrestleMania 42 will be available in the following countries: Argentina, Austria, Australia, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Colombia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Ecuador, Egypt, Finland, Germany, Greece, Hong Kong, Hungary, Indonesia, Israel, Italy, Kuwait, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Peru, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Slovakia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, Ukraine, and United Kingdom. Audiences in the USA will be able to stream both nights of WrestleMania on ESPN which also requires a subscription. What Audio Options is Netflix Providing for WrestleMania 42? Typically, there are several language teams at WWE Premium Live Events, but it remains unclear if any other languages will be available outside of the country you’re streaming from. In the US, it has been confirmed that English and Spanish will be available to Peacock audiences. WrestleMania 42 Night 1 Full Card There will be 7 matches on Night 1 of the WrestleMania card. No. Match Stipulation 1 The Vision and IShowSpeed vs. The Usos and LA Knight Six-man tag team match 2 Jacob Fatu vs. Drew McIntyre Unsanctioned match 3 The Iresistible Forces (c) vs Charlotte Flair and Alexa Bliss vs. Bayley and Lyra Valkyria vs. The Bella Twins Fatal four-way tag team match for the WWE Women’s Tag Team Championship 4 AJ Lee (c) vs. Becky Lynch Singles match for the WWE Women’s Intercontinental Championship 5 Seth Rollins vs. Gunther Singles match 6 Stephanie Vaquer (c) vs. Liv Morgan Singles match for the Women’s World Championship 7 Cody Rhodes (c) vs. Randy Orton (with Pat McAfee) Singles match for the Undisputed WWE Championship – McAfee must leave the professional wrestling industry permanently if Randy Orton loses. No. Match Stipulation 1 Oba Femi vs. Brock Lesnar Singles match 2 Penta (c) vs. Je’Von Evans vs. Dragon Lee vs. JD McDonagh vs. Rusev vs. Rey Mysterio Six-pack ladder match for the WWE Intercontinental Championship 3 Sami Zayn (c) vs. Trick Williams (with Lil Yachty) Singles match for the WWE United States Championship[ 4 “The Demon” Finn Bálor vs. Dominik Mysterio Singles match 5 Jade Cargill (c) vs. Rhea Ripley Singles match for the WWE Women’s Championship[ 6 CM Punk (c) vs. Roman Reigns Singles match for the World Heavyweight Championship (c)* = Champion WrestleMania card is subject to change. Can I stream WrestleMania 42 after the Main Event? Certainly. Once WrestleMania 42 concludes, Netflix will keep the PLE available on VOD. This means subscribers can watch the event at their convenience. Please note that if your Netflix language settings are not set to English, you may not be able to find the match VOD immediately after. How long will WrestleMania 42 Last? There isn’t a specific run time that Premium Live Events, such as WrestleMania, adhere to. The total runtime of WrestleMania 41 across both nights was just over 7 hours (Night 1: 223 minutes – Night 2: 198 minutes). WrestleMania is the biggest weekend of professional wrestling, and we’d expect WrestleMania 42 to have a runtime of at least 6.5 hours. What to watch before Wrestlemania 42? If you haven’t got the time to catch up on weeks’ worth of WWE, then we propose, at the very least, that you watch the “go home” shows of Raw and SmackDown. These final shows before WrestleMania set up the rest of the card and build the event’s hype. Each episode is crucial to understanding the storylines heading into both nights of WrestleMania 42. Are you looking forward to watching WrestleMania 42 on Netflix? Let us know in the comments below!
